title: mfa-engine: a reusable dynamic material flow analysis engine linked to critical raw material trade risk
description:
A reusable dynamic material flow analysis (dMFA) engine covering the three standard driving modes: register-based, inflow-driven and stock-driven. It is applied to Denmark's wind turbine fleet (from the national turbine register), the global electric vehicle fleet and global data centres, and tracks inflow, in-use stock, end-of-life outflow and recovery for materials including copper, lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, graphite, steel and the rare earths neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium and terbium, with a mass balance checked every year.

Projected recovery is linked to 2023 UN Comtrade bilateral trade data from crm-trade-network for supply concentration (HHI), a linear-threshold cascade model with a failure-threshold sweep, and a linear program for the minimum trade reallocation that meets the EU Critical Raw Materials Act's 65% single-country benchmark. Includes an interactive Streamlit dashboard: https://mfa-engine-production.up.railway.app/
